svg.text: Kerf-bend the hood and set the roller yokes
The guard that is also the dust hood, plus the rollers that kill snipe.
Rev B geometry · fab B.4 · inches
Confirm flange BCD before drilling · FABRICATION REVIEW
Grey = already built · colour = this step
Kerf-bend the hood blank around the drum arc, glue the form, fill the kerfs, and fit
Hang both roller yokes on shoulder-bolt pivots with light compression springs.
Set each roller 0.030″ below the drum OD with paper on, using feeler gauges.
Check the hood clears the drum, the rollers, and the oscillator stroke if you fitted
PARTS TRAY — fetch these before you start
TOOLS: Table saw (kerfing) · Feeler gauges · Drill
OPEN THESE SHEETS: P-011 · P-014 · A-05
Both rollers 0.030″ below drum OD, paper on. Hood seats
Still correctable after this step: Spring rate and roller
⚠ Hood ON is the primary guard. Open it only with the machine
